main.description: A space you've designed in proto town: what's placed where in your home or your neighborhood yard. Record key is the space: 'home' or 'yard'. Public, like every record: it holds item references and positions only.

space.description: Which space this layout furnishes. Matches the record key.

placement.description: One placed object. Set exactly one of `item` (an object you own) or `builtin` (a starter object every space has).

item.description: An equipment.rpg.item world object in the layout owner's own repo.

builtin.description: A starter object id from the app's built-in catalog (e.g. 'couch', 'pine').

x.description: Tile column of the object's top-left footprint tile.

y.description: Tile row of the object's top-left footprint tile.

rotation.description: Facing: 0 down, 1 left, 2 right, 3 up (within what the object supports).
